unit: CH-03 F053 / F116 - private typed-boundary convergence, authorized backend Meetings pass, institutions classification

measurementFactDiscovered.fact: TYPED_DESERIALIZATION_BOUNDARY is ENUMERATED but is NOT gate debt. The ratchet counts only NON_CONFORMANT + ADHOC_MAP_EXTRACTION_IN_SURFACE.
measurementFactDiscovered.consequence: Converging a private type can lower the enumerated typed-boundary total without moving the gate number at all. Type-level convergence is therefore reported as its own count, never folded into the debt figure - otherwise the two would silently disagree.

case1_renamedSubset_retired.was: id + handle + displayName + avatarUrl, with its OWN private fallback `displayName ?? handle`
case1_renamedSubset_retired.action: DELETED. Moderation actors are AuraPersonIdentity like everyone else. Its two consumers (moderator, reporter) now hold the canonical type; one call site read `.id` and now reads `.userId`.

case1_renamedSubset_retired.was: id + handle + displayName + avatarUrl with a private `avatarUrl ?? avatar` fallback
case1_renamedSubset_retired.action: The NAME survives because callers use it; the INTERPRETATION does not. It composes AuraPersonIdentity and forwards, with the legacy `avatar` alias adapted at that boundary rather than widening the canonical reader.
DELETED in the previous batch - dead, zero consumers.

case2_identityPlusDestinationState_compo.action: Composes `AuraPersonIdentity person`; forwarding getters keep every consumer working. Membership state stayed put - none of it moved into person identity.

case2_identityPlusDestinationState_compo.destinationState: bio, title, coverUrl, location, follower/following counts, isFollowing, verification, followState, accountStatus
case2_identityPlusDestinationState_compo.action: The person half reads canonically; profile CONTENT stays this model's own.

case3_differentDomainConcept_retained.why: POLYMORPHIC by design - a feed actor is a person OR an institution (`FeedAuthorType`, `handleOrSlug`, `avatarOrLogoUrl`). Composing person identity would either force person semantics onto institutions or invent a union type. Person and institution identity must not merge.

Spans an Aura user, an institution member, AND an external contact (`auraUserId` / `memberId` / `contactId`, `email`, `verifiedEmail`, `identityType`). AuraPersonIdentity deliberately does not model non-Aura contacts.

case3_differentDomainConcept_retained.type: Feed/realtime/meeting/updates/follows/blocks domain models (feed_item, post, post_model, realtime_models, meeting, availability_profile, meeting_entry_resolution, updates_repository, follows_repository, blocks_repository, conversations_repository, articles_repository, explore_feed_item, support_models)
case3_differentDomainConcept_retained.why: These are content, relationship, session, availability and support domain objects that happen to deserialise a person field. Their identity parsing converges as their surfaces migrate; the TYPES themselves are not person models and are not being unified for tidiness.

case5_specializedGovernedException.why: Reads the CLAIMANT's own account (id + email + displayName) to match a verification request by email. It embeds no person in a response and renders nothing; composing the full reference would attach an avatar to a claim check for no consumer. Rationale recorded in the code.
Credential/account-state reads, as accepted in the previous checkpoint.

case6_falsePositive_instrumentIssue.thisBatch: NONE. Every count change is real migration or real type retirement.
case6_falsePositive_instrumentIssue.previousBatch: The router pathParameters['handle'] correction, already reported separately.

circleAvatarDisposition.status: CLASSIFIED AS A GROUP, NOT MIGRATED THIS BATCH
circleAvatarDisposition.why: The founder's own rule: not every CircleAvatar is wrong. Deciding each of the 15 requires reading what it renders - a person, a non-person object, or a deliberately specialised treatment - and that judgment is the work, not the edit. Doing it half-attentively to move a number is exactly what the instruction warns against.
circleAvatarDisposition.nextPass: Classify A (person identity bypassing Aura presentation - converge), B (non-person visual - leave), C (specialised treatment where identity semantics should still come from AuraPersonIdentity while presentation stays local).
